packageRules.description: Pinned to an exact v1 rc, and always together: the migrator (packages/core/db/migrate-tree.ts, migrate-apply.ts) and the layout tools rely on properties of that rc's folder layout, snapshots and `check`, asserted by packages/core/__tests__/migration-layout.test.ts and apps/web/tests/db/migration-layout-v1.test.ts. A bump is a person's review of those two, never an automerge.

One Playwright version for the whole repo: each version owns one Chromium build and `playwright install` from another version deletes it. apps/runner/package.json is the pin the runner image reads; scripts/playwright-pin.test.ts fails on drift.
TypeScript 7 is a native-first rewrite that dropped lib/typescript.js; Next.js 16 can't detect it. Hold at 5.x until Next.js ships stable TS7 support.
